messages:
Maya (Design): quick thing \/ the run-history payloads are overwhelming when tool calls return big objects. can we show a compact summary by default?
Ernest (DevEx): yes — proposal: show first N top-level keys as key: value pairs, then a +N overflow badge. no horizontal scroll.
Samir (PM): also surface the function name and schema version visibly so folks know which signature produced it.
Ellie (A11y): a11y note: the summary region must be keyboard focusable and announce 'summary collapsed, 3 keys visible' to SR users.
Maya (Design): mock: tiny chevron button next to the header to expand, and a separate 'Show full output' CTA at the card level. chevron has aria-label 'Expand payload'.
Ernest (DevEx): implementation idea: reuse CodeBlock but render a schema-aware compact view when collapsed. pseudo: 
```\n<CodeBlock collapsed schema={fnSchema} previewKeys={3} />\n```
Samir (PM): include a copy summary button on the compact view for quick sharing.
Ellie (A11y): copy button needs aria-live feedback 'Copied summary' and a visible focus rectangle. also ensure aria-controls points to the expanded panel.
Maya (Design): UX detail: overflow badge should be small and keyboard reachable, reads '+2 more' and opens a mini popover list on hover/focus.
Ernest (DevEx): perf note: avoid stringifying full JSON on every render. store the compact summary on the invocation object at write-time.
Maya (Design): error states: if tool call failed show inline red pill 'Tool error' with secondary link 'open trace' and a tooltip 'See logs and schema mismatch'.
Samir (PM): put a small 'schema matched' check icon when payload conforms to the declared function schema, else show 'schema mismatch' with help text.
Ellie (A11y): test checklist for PR: keyboard expand/collapse, screen-reader announcements for collapsed/expanded, copy feedback, focus order correctness.
ci-bot: CI pipeline triggered for feature/compact-preview (build #5178) :white_check_mark:
Ernest (DevEx): I'll spike this behind a feature flag, add aria attributes, and return with a demo in design sync.
Maya (Design): sweet. copy strings to use: 'Expand payload' / 'Collapse payload' and card action 'Show full output'. keep microcopy terse.
Ellie (A11y): tagging for accessibility review once PR is up. thanks y'all :sparkles:
